B8.brief: bench/results/heldout/G9/run-2/B8/brief.md: 'B8 · Hand the library a new emote'. A co-op game set aboard an orbital repair station (Night Shift): the crew gather in the station's hub between jobs, and each player can play an emote from the comms panel. The panel needs one the library doesn't have, and what the team builds from the library goes back into it. It describes the workspace's character as seed 7359 generates it. The job is reworded with every requirement kept: an emote of the agent's choosing for character.glb from the CC0 library, sent with npx m3a library submit until it waits in awaiting review with every check green; new to the library and not sent with --improves; on the spot (no walking or running as npx m3a describe reads it, under a quarter of its hip height travelled); tagged emote, with a name and a description of its own; complete provenance (method and tool, a CC0 claim, the maker an AI agent named with its Claude model); the local backend in .cache/intake/, checked every 30 s, the hosted queue every 15 minutes; npx m3a library status for states and bounce reasons. The grading paragraph is B8.md's word for word (copied with awk and compared: identical).
B8.character: gen-7359: tall build (thin), T rest pose (upper arms and forearms level, 0° below), Rigify naming in metres (armature unscaled), facing +z, left on +x, twist bones in the chains, shoulders left out: DEF-spine (hips, the skeleton's root, 1.2492 m above the origin, 1.257 m above the soles), DEF-spine.001 to .003 up the back, DEF-spine.004 and .005 the neck, DEF-spine.006 the head; DEF-upper_arm.L, DEF-upper_arm.L.001, DEF-forearm.L, DEF-forearm.L.001, DEF-hand.L on DEF-spine.003; DEF-thigh.L, DEF-thigh.L.001, DEF-shin.L, DEF-foot.L, DEF-toe.L on DEF-spine; the same with .R; 27 bones, one skinned mesh, mesh y -0.008 to 2.136 m (2.14 m tall), x ±1.077 m; three.js loads the names with the dots dropped (DEF-spine001, DEF-upper_armL001).
